authoritative_freeze_timestamp: GitHub protected-main merge event for this amendment; dates before promotion describe candidate bytes, not acceptance.
supersedes: The EFR-R2 permitted specification package bound by EFR-001-R2-INPUT-AMENDMENT-1.1 only. No endpoint, threshold, sample or stratum count, inclusion/exclusion rule, allocation, missing-data rule, analysis, or other registered test is amended.

defect.summary: Under the v1.1-bound specifications, the reference verifiers that generate the frozen expected result were defective or nondeterministic on some records, and the bound text still left some reference outputs undetermined.
findings: The far-ir/2.0 reference verifier identified quotient classes by id: a repeated class id merged two declared classes, so a split partition was certified PROVED as the exact observational quotient and an exact partition with a repeated id was rejected, contrary to section 3.3.

Overlapping quotient classes produced class-relation diagnostics computed from an arbitrary last-wins assignment instead of QUOTIENT_NOT_PARTITION, contrary to the published definition 'the declared classes do not partition source_domain'.

The reference intake accepted the non-JSON constants NaN and Infinity and resolved duplicate object keys last-wins, so a record whose outcome a first-wins JSON parser reads as REFUTED was certified PROVED.

A FROZEN far-ir/2.0 record with a null or non-RFC3339 frozen_at was accepted: section 5 requires an RFC3339 time, the repository-local JSON Schema validator ignored the schema's if/then constraint, and format is an annotation.
The far-ir/2.1 reference verifier ordered METRIC_LOSS_DOMAIN_MISMATCH and LOSS_METRIC_MISMATCH by Python set iteration, so the normative sequence varied with PYTHONHASHSEED.

The far-ir/2.1 text read as grouping metric-axiom codes by code while the reference interleaves them; a spec-derived clean-room oracle disagreed with the reference on order for 1211 of 4000 random records.
Canonical JSON for contract_sha256, table-value equality, and the quotient pair iteration order were unspecified.
defect.consequence: Correct clean-room implementations of the v1.1-bound text could disagree with the frozen expected result because of reference-verifier defects or undetermined text, not because of far-ir semantics.

reference_verifier_change: The far-ir/2.0 and far-ir/2.1 reference verifiers were repaired to match the v1.2-bound text. Any EFR-R2 frozen expected result must be generated by the repaired verifiers. The executed PCA-W5 and PCA-W6 verifier bytes are preserved as frozen campaign inputs and are not EFR-R2 inputs.

mandatory_consequence.rule: EFR-R2 MUST NOT execute against the v1.2-corrected specifications under amendment v1.1 or the unamended v1.0 freeze.
mandatory_consequence.basis: EFR-001 v1.0 permits later intake to supply only identities, dates, sources and observations, and permits no later scientific design choices. Which specification bytes a clean-room team receives is a design choice.
mandatory_consequence.effect_if_violated: The test becomes retrospectively specified and forfeits confirmatory status.

canonical_pre_execution_state.claim: Before this correction, the canonical EFR authorities recorded no sealed R2 input, executed R2 test, or external case.
canonical_pre_execution_state.scope_boundary: These repository checks do not establish the global nonexistence of unregistered external files, communications, private experiments, or other activity outside the canonical EFR intake. Any such undisclosed activity, if it existed, is governed by the v1.0 exposure/protocol-breach rules.

bound_specification_package.role: W3 comparison-contract specification including diagnostic vocabulary, sequence/suppression semantics, class identity, value equality, intake, and canonical JSON
W5 approximation/cost specification including diagnostic vocabulary, gate semantics, and exact metric-axiom and loss-check order

artifact_hash_semantics: Git blob object IDs bind exact bytes including the blob header; the promotion commit/tree additionally binds path and mode.
prohibited_inputs_unchanged: Project FAR verifier, checker, test, oracle or other implementation source
internal_declaration_not_in_r2_package: mechanization/far_mechanization/diagnostic_vocabulary.py remains an internal consistency declaration but is not supplied to clean-room teams because the specifications publish the complete diagnostic tables.
nonclaims: does not make EFR-R2 acceptance more likely
does not establish external independence, replication, novelty, or empirical utility
does not establish that the corrected specification is sufficient for independent convergence, which is what EFR-R2 tests
does not establish global nonexistence of activity outside canonical EFR intake
does not change any assurance dimension
does not establish that the repaired reference verifiers are correct beyond the audited defects
